issues.title: CQL regex string operators did not use required single-line regex mode
issues.evidence:
The CQL reference requires regex operators to use single-line mode. Direct and translated Matches('a
b', 'a.b') returned false, ReplaceMatches('a
b', 'a.b', 'x') returned the original string, and SplitOnMatches('a
b', '.') left the newline unsplit.
issues.fix: Updated Matches, ReplaceMatches, and SplitOnMatches SQL macros to pass DuckDB regex option 's' (and 'gs' for global replace). Updated deprecated stringMatches to use re.DOTALL and return NULL for null patterns; hardened deprecated stringReplace null operands for row resilience.
issues.verification: Covered by translated native-loaded and forced Python fallback execution plus no-Python/browser-style direct macro probes. Full CQL and all-spec conformance remained at 100%.
